name: m5-super-invokespecial-spike
description: Spike on m5-pro (profile, not timing): do mixin forwarders that `invokespecial` a directly extended trait's method, instead of calling its static `m$`, remove the remaining `lookup_secondary_supers_table_slow_path_stub` samples? Each build is compiled by a local STARR from its own source: `hot2` by `666cbbf` (no codegen change), `codegen` by `d30c2e9` (with it). One round, kperf, typer-only scala corpus.

variantDescriptions.hot2: hot `Types` code in nested classes, `666cbbf3e3`, built by STARR `2.13.19-bin-666cbbf-SNAPSHOT`
variantDescriptions.codegen: `hot2` + super calls to direct-parent traits as `invokespecial`, `d30c2e9246`, built by STARR `2.13.19-bin-d30c2e9-SNAPSHOT`
